title: [YSQL] Buffering causes writes to be missed during procedure calls
body:
Buffering seems to cause writes to be missed during procedure calls - specifically the last write is missed.

Test case:
```
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE put_test(IN ecx_sps text[])                                              
LANGUAGE plpgsql                                                                                     
AS $$                                                                                                
DECLARE                                                                                              
    val text;                                                                                        
    ecx_sp_array text[];                                                                             
BEGIN                                                                                                
    FOREACH val IN ARRAY ecx_sps LOOP                                                                
        ecx_sp_array := string_to_array(val, '|', 'null');                                           
        INSERT INTO test                                                                             
        VALUES (ecx_sp_array[1], ecx_sp_array[2])                                                    
        ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT test_pkey                                                          
        DO UPDATE SET b = ecx_sp_array[2];                                                           
    END LOOP;                                                                                        
    COMMIT;                                                                                          
END;                                                                                                 
$$;

CREATE TABLE test(a text PRIMARY KEY, b text);

yugabyte=# CALL put_test(ARRAY['1|1','2|2','1|3']);                                                                                                                             CALL
yugabyte=# select * from test;
 a | b 
---+---
 2 | 2
 1 | 1
(2 rows)

yugabyte=# CALL put_test(ARRAY['4|4']);
CALL
yugabyte=# select * from test;
 a | b 
---+---
 2 | 2
 1 | 1
(2 rows)

yugabyte=# CALL put_test(ARRAY['4|4','5|5']);
CALL
yugabyte=# select * from test;
 a | b 
---+---
 2 | 2
 4 | 4
 1 | 1
(3 rows)
```

If I restart tservers with `--ysql_session_max_batch_size=1`, then I don't see this behavior anymore and all the records are inserted correctly as expected.

```
./bin/yb-ctl restart --tserver_flags ysql_session_max_batch_size=1
./bin/ysqlsh
yugabyte=# truncate test;
TRUNCATE TABLE
yugabyte=# select * from test;
 a | b 
---+---
(0 rows)

yugabyte=# CALL put_test(ARRAY['1|1','2|2','1|3']);
CALL
yugabyte=# select * from test;
 a | b 
---+---
 2 | 2
 1 | 3
(2 rows)

yugabyte=# CALL put_test(ARRAY['4|4']);
CALL
yugabyte=# select * from test;
 a | b 
---+---
 2 | 2
 4 | 4
 1 | 3
(3 rows)

yugabyte=# CALL put_test(ARRAY['4|4','5|5']);
CALL
yugabyte=# select * from test;
 a | b 
---+---
 2 | 2
 4 | 4
 5 | 5
 1 | 3
(4 rows)
```
